what: Two frame screens, S01 — Sign in and S02 — Home, each with an "Approved" box in its top-right corner (`s01-approval`, `s02-approval`), and the markup legend beside them. A person drew one green stroke inside S01's box in a real tab.
why: ADR-005 (SPEC-007 test cases 1 and 2): a ticked box approves its screen, an empty one does not, and neither box is read as a checkbox or any component of the design; the tick is no annotation.
notes: Drawn 2026-11-17 on port 3072: the screens, the boxes and the legend by the CLI (`apply`), the tick in the browser pane with the editor's pen in the stroke picker's green. Exported with `excalidraw-canvas export`, which kept the tick's origin. The only patch: the tick's random id was renamed `tick-s01`.
The legend here is the version with the approval line ("Done with a screen? Tick its Approved box, top right."), 12 elements; markup-legend holds the earlier one, 11.
